title: Daily log rotation testable without clock or disk
task: Implement `rotate.Rotator`: given a log path like `app.log`, when the calendar date has changed since the last write it renames the file to `app.log.YYYY-MM-DD` (yesterday's date) and then appends the line to a fresh `app.log`; otherwise it just appends. It must be fully testable without touching the real clock or the real filesystem, and the tests must not sleep.
